messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: kv-cache-gpu-3 write latency > 350ms (p95) — paging oncall

nora: I got the page, looking now. seeing write latency spikes on the cache nodes in us-west-2. not sure if it's load or a backfill job.

alex: I can pull perf histograms and connection counts. will post graphs in a sec.

maya: tagging infra, any recent deploys to kv-cache? @ops-bot any job restarts?

ops-bot: Deploys: none in last 30m. Autoscaler scaled kv-cache-gpu-3 from 8 -> 10 pods 14m ago. Backpressure alerts started ~12m ago.

samir: I see a bunch of reroute errors from the proxy layer to those nodes. Possibly overloaded CPUs hitting context switch. shifting small traffic to fallback pool now.

nora: ok doing live reroute: set route policy to prefer-pool=fallback-cache for 30m. Applying: 
```
redwoodctl routing update kv-cache --from pool=primary --to pool=fallback-cache --duration 30m
```

viktor: pinging downstream services to check customer impact. I see 3 API customers with elevated 5xxs that correlate. DMing their CSMs.

alex: attaching quick graphs: p95 latency jump at 12:02, tps steady. looks like per-request CPU spike.

maya: for mitigation, suggest immediate silence for the noisy alert while we verify thresholding and add a short maintenance window to avoid alert storms as we roll the fallback.

nora: agreed. creating silence for alert id `kv-cache-write-p95` for 45m. will annotate with rationale.

ops-bot: Silence created: kv-cache-write-p95, expires in 45m. created by nora. annotation: "temporary silence during live reroute and triage to prevent alert flood"

samir: also adding a 60m maintenance window on the affected service group to prevent automated escalations during rollout.

nora: can someone add a dashboard panel for cache write distribution (p50/p90/p95/p99) and a simple histogram of per-request CPU? we'll want that for postmortem + threshold tuning.

alex: adding dashboard now, panel id: 8472. query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_write_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le)`. will share a snapshot.

viktor: I'm collecting customer impact summary: 3 customers had increased error-rate up to 4% for ~18m, no data loss reported. sending heads-up to support ops.

maya: quick note: we should not tighten p95 threshold further — it looks like transient CPU noise. post-incident we may add a short moving-average-based alert to avoid spikes triggering pages.

nora: marking actions: 1) reroute to fallback (done) 2) created silence (done) 3) maintenance window (done) 4) dashboard panel (in progress) 5) collect perf traces and core dumps if available. assigning owners: alex (graphs/traces), samir (proxy config), maya (alerts tuning), viktor (customer comms).

alex: uploaded trace bundle to s3://redwood-debug/kv-cache/1948765432/trace.tar.gz and link in the dashboard.

incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff at 1948768000 scheduled. nora — do you want to handoff now or keep until resolved?

nora: I'll stay on for now; if we hit steady state in 20m I'll handoff to kate.

kate: I can take it at handoff, will review the dashboard snapshot and the silence settings.

maya: quick preliminary tuning suggestion: replace immediate p95 alert with a 3m avg p95 + increase threshold to 400ms for kv-cache-gpu-3, and add an escalation only if both p95 > 400ms and error-rate > 1% for 5m. This should cut noise.

samir: that sounds reasonable. after we validate traces, we should implement as a canary change to one AZ and monitor for 1h.

nora: agreed. once we verify, we should: 1) push alert rule update 2) remove the temporary silence 3) schedule a post-incident audit of all cache alerts. maya, can you own the PR?

maya: on it. will open PR for rule change and add unit tests for moving-average logic.

viktor: customer comms updated. no escalations requested. monitoring tickets created for the three impacted customers.

alex: latency is trending down after reroute. p95 back to ~220ms. keeping the silence until we finalize thresholds.

ops-bot: Silence kv-cache-write-p95 expires in 24m (from now). Maintenance window ends in 36m.

nora: thanks team. we'll reconvene in the postmortem channel with follow-ups. leaving brief note here for the audit: "live reroute, silence, maintenance window, dashboards added, alert rule PR opened (maya)."

kate: picking this up at handoff. thanks — I'll validate the PR and make sure the silence is removed after the new rule is active. :thumbsup:
